name: Facebook

disclosure.zh: Meta 的「AI 信息」标签：视频是逼真的 AI 生成或修改时，在发布页打开「AI 信息」（或在文字里说明）。Reel 竖屏 9:16；动态视频 4:5 或 16:9。正文里的链接在动态里可点，在 Reel 文案里不一定。
disclosure.en: Meta "AI info": when the video is realistic AI-made or AI-altered, turn on the AI label on the post page (or say so in the text). Reels 9:16; feed video 4:5 or 16:9. Links in the text are clickable in feed posts, not reliably in Reels captions.

guide.zh: 在 Facebook 首页点「Reel」或「照片/视频」（主页请用 Meta Business Suite → 创建 Reel），出现上传框后应用会放入视频并填好文字。检查受众和封面，再由你点「分享 / 发布」。
guide.en: On Facebook click Reel or Photo/video (Pages: Meta Business Suite → Create reel). When the upload box appears the app adds the video and types the text. Check the audience and cover, then press Share / Post yourself.

zh: 发布到个人主页还是公共主页

notes: UNVERIFIED selectors (written 2026-10 without a logged-in session): check them on the live page, then set status to verified + lastVerified.
Desktop Reel upload may be Pages-only for some accounts (3P, unconfirmed); the composer on the home page always takes a video post.
No API fill: the Graph API posts Reels for Pages only (see the engine's references/PUBLISHING.md).
